title: English Practice Quiz 0971
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: When handing over a shift, the outgoing guard should provide ___.
options: a clear account of pending matters
questions.explanation: A useful handover records important events and unfinished tasks.

questions.question: Which sentence gives a clear instruction?
questions.explanation: A clear instruction states exactly what action is needed.

questions.question: A colleague reports a problem. What is a suitable response?
options: I will check it and update you.
questions.explanation: This response acknowledges the issue and promises a follow-up.

questions.question: The phrase 'follow up on a request' means to ___.
questions.explanation: Following up means checking what has happened since the request.

questions.question: Which detail is most useful in a shift handover?
options: the time and status of an unresolved issue
questions.explanation: Time and current status help the next team continue the work.

questions.question: If an instruction is unclear, you should ___.
questions.explanation: Clarification reduces mistakes caused by misunderstanding.

questions.question: Which phrase confirms that you have understood?
options: Understood. I will complete it before noon.
questions.explanation: The reply confirms understanding and states the intended action.

questions.question: A 'priority' task is one that ___.
options: needs attention before less important tasks
questions.explanation: A priority task is given greater importance or urgency.

questions.question: When reporting a delay, include ___.
options: the reason and revised expected time
questions.explanation: The reason and updated time help others plan.

questions.question: Which is the most professional way to request assistance?
options: Could you assist me with this task, please?
I need you because I said so.
questions.explanation: This wording is polite and direct.
